card.name: Final part of MAVYRET brand name
card.fires_on: The closing piece "RET" of the brand name MAVYRET (glecaprevir/pibrentasvir) in hepatitis C drug label text. It fires right after "MAVY".

modes.label: MAVYRET name ending
modes.description: The "RET" piece completing MAVYRET when the drug is named in interaction, warning or dosing statements.
modes.example: Test all patients for evidence of current or prior hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection before initiating treatment with MAVY<<RET>>.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the last syllable of the hepatitis C drug name MAVYRET.
